Makes a bus feed another bus. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
; Entering the cave: the cave sounds go through the world bus, so the pause menu turns them down too.
AudioBusParent cave, world
```
@param bus  A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus). The master bus feeds nothing, so `0` is a runtime error.
@param parent  The bus to feed, `0` for the master bus. A bus that would feed itself, through any number of buses, is a runtime error.
@gap [GetAudioBusParent](GetAudioBusParent) tells the bus that one feeds.
